title: Catch Piggy
description: Pick three matching cartoon piggies and toys from a physics pile into your tray to clear the whole board before the timer runs out.
controls: Tap toys and piggies to move them into the 7-slot tray; match three identical items to clear them.

zh-CN.title: 抓小猪
zh-CN.description: 在物理堆叠的萌趣玩具与小猪堆里挑出三个相同物品凑对消除，活用冰冻与磁铁道具通关。
zh-CN.controls: 点击画面中的小猪或玩具放入底部 7 格托盘，集齐 3 个相同物品自动消除。
